title: Factory Acquires Typedef To Help AI Agents Navigate Enterprise Data
summary:
The software firm behind AI-powered engineering agents has bought a company that specializes in how autonomous systems interpret corporate information. Factory will use Typedef's context layer to strengthen the ability of its AI tools to navigate and process internal corporate datasets more effectively.

The integration is intended to provide Factory's AI 'Droids' and its human engineers with more precise data lineage and evidence during development. The company will apply these capabilities to help its users plan system migrations, debug pipelines, and refactor software models.
